text: dsh-works-gallery 是一款面向 DSH web 客户端的作品库插件，通过右侧栏标签展示工作区中的图片和视频。它扫描配置的目录并按修改时间排列媒体文件，提供图片和视频筛选、文件名搜索、全屏预览、在文件管理器中定位及复制路径，也可将选中的媒体移入系统回收站。默认扫描 DSH 工作区目录，可通过 DSH_WORKS_GALLERY_ROOTS 指定目录；不需要 API 密钥或外部服务。

dsh-works-gallery adds a sidebar gallery to DSH web. It scans workspace images and videos, with filters, search, previews, file reveal and path copying. Selected media can go to system trash. No key or external service is needed.
想在 DSH 侧边栏集中找回工作区里生成过的图片和视频。
有没有办法按日期浏览 DSH 工作区的媒体文件并快速预览？
I want a sidebar gallery to browse and preview images and clips from my DSH workspace.
dsh-works-gallery 的功能「媒体作品浏览」：打开右侧栏 Gallery 标签后，插件扫描工作区根目录中的图片和视频，按修改时间新到旧列出；用户可切换媒体类型、搜索文件名并打开预览。
dsh-works-gallery 的功能「定位或整理媒体文件」：在预览中可复制路径或在系统文件管理器中显示文件；选择缩略图并确认删除后，插件会将符合条件的媒体移入系统回收站。

dsh-works-gallery README · dsh-works-gallery 作品库：**English** · [中文](README.zh.md) A right-sidebar tab for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) that shows **every image and video made in your workspaces**, newest first, as a thumbnail wall. No more scrolling back through old chats to find the poster you generated last week.

dsh-works-gallery README · What it does：- **Scans, does not index.** Walks the workspace roots on request (10 s cache) and lists every
  `.png .jpg .jpeg .webp .gif .avif .bmp .svg .mp4 .webm .mov .m4v .mkv` file it finds.
- **Newest first, grouped by day** — `Today`, `Yesterday`, then plain dates.
- **Thumbnail wall** — images lazy-load, videos show a muted first frame with a play badge.
- **Click to open** a full-screen lightbox: images at full size, videos with controls and seeking
  (the file route speaks `Range`, so scrubbing works).
- **Filters** — All / Images / Videos, plus a file-name search across path and name.
- **Show in folder** and **copy path** straight from the lightbox.
- **Tidy up without fear.** Hit **Select**, tick any number of thumbnails, and **Delete** moves them
  to the OS recycle bin — one click restores them from there. Non-media files, and anything outside
  the roots, is refused by the host.
- **Read-only by default.** Only the delete route touches the disk, and only for the files you
  ticked that live under a root.

dsh-works-gallery README · Where the files come from：By default it scans the directory DSH keeps its workspaces in:

| OS | Default root |
| --- | --- |
| Windows | `%USERPROFILE%\Documents\deepseek-harness` |
| macOS / Linux | `~/Documents/deepseek-harness` |

If that directory does not exist it falls back to `~/Documents`. Override with
`DSH_WORKS_GALLERY_ROOTS` — several roots separated by `;` on Windows and `:` elsewhere:

```bash

dsh-works-gallery README · macOS / Linux：export DSH_WORKS_GALLERY_ROOTS="$HOME/renders:$HOME/screenshots"
```

Every `/file` and `/api/reveal` request is checked against those roots **after resolving symlinks**,
so a link inside a root cannot be used to read something outside it. Only media extensions are served.

dsh-works-gallery README · Open it：Right sidebar → **Guidance / 引导** tab → the **Gallery / 作品库** capsule. In the right sidebar's
tab bar it stays available as its own tab afterwards.

dsh-works-gallery README · HTTP routes：| Route | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `GET /api/list` | `{ ok, roots, total, truncated, items[] }`, newest first, capped at 5000 entries / depth 8 |
| `GET /file?path=…` | Streams one media file; supports `Range` (206) so video seeking works |
| `GET /api/reveal?path=…` | Reveals the file in Explorer / Finder / the desktop file manager |
| `POST /api/delete` | `{ paths: [...] }` (max 300) → moves each file to the OS recycle bin. Returns `{ ok, deleted[], failed[{path,error}] }`; paths outside the roots, or without a media extension, are refused |

dsh-works-gallery README · HTTP routes：Skipped while scanning: `node_modules`, `.git`, `.cache`, `dist`, `venv`, `__pycache__`, dot-directories
and other dependency/build folders.

dsh-works-gallery README · Requirements：- DeepSeek Harness with the right sidebar (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-sidebar-right`)
- Node.js >= 20
